question: Which claims in the unsupported COMP-038 July addendum are directly reconstructable from De Baere 2013 and Gu 2026, and what source-access and validation boundaries apply?

query_attempts.error: The official record reproduced the primary abstract and supported the recorded abstract-level method fields, but a full article was not available through the accessed path.

load_bearing_verifications.claim: De Baere supports bacterial-culture-supernatant HPLC-UV at 210 nm after ether back-extraction and acidification below pH 2, with matrix-matched 0.5-50 mM calibration and analyte-spanning LOD/LOQ ranges of 0.13-0.33/0.5-1.0 mM.
The accessible De Baere source does not explicitly support the shorthand underivatized.

Gu used the VBS-100/G3-electrode, alkaline butyrate pretreatment, voltammetric feature-extraction, and ANN stack and compared its predictions with GC-MS in a within-study independent 30-sample fecal test cohort.

Gu reported fecal test-cohort butyrate MAE/RMSE/R2 of 0.029 mM/0.034 mM/0.998, 24 of 30 samples within plus or minus five percent, and a -0.015 mM bias with limits -0.065 to 0.035 mM and p-values 0.0027/0.0031.
The Gu test cohort is within the source study and does not establish independent external replication or Open Enzyme method qualification.
No evidence artifact establishes that a July 14 full-text verification of both papers occurred.
load_bearing_verifications.primary_source: Git history and reachable COMP-038 artifact history

limitations: This was targeted verification of two named sources, not a refreshed assay-landscape search or systematic review.
The De Baere full article was not available through the accessed path, so its retained claims are limited to fields stated in the primary abstract.
The Gu source reports within-study test-cohort performance and does not supply independent external replication.
Neither source qualifies a method for an Open Enzyme matrix or workflow.
No non-English text was encountered, so the two-model translation protocol was not triggered.
errors: De Baere full text was unavailable through the accessed official record; the verification was deliberately downgraded to primary-abstract scope.
